articles.title_en: Financial Disruptions and the Organization of Innovation: Evidence from the Great Depression
articles.title_cn: 金融冲击与创新组织：来自大萧条的证据
articles.abstract_en: We examine innovation following the Great Depression using data on a century’s worth of U.S. patents and a difference-in-differences design that exploits regional variation in the crisis severity. Harder-hit areas experienced large and persistent declines in independent patenting, mostly reflecting the disruption in access to finance during the crisis. This decline was larger for young and inexperienced inventors and lower-quality patents. In contrast, innovation by large firms increased, especially among young and inexperienced inventors. Overall, the Great Depression contributed to the decline in technological entrepreneurship and accelerated the shift of innovation into larger firms.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用一个世纪的美国专利数据以及利用危机严重程度的地区差异的双重差分设计，研究了大萧条之后的创新。受冲击更严重的地区在独立专利方面经历了大幅且持续的下降，这主要反映了危机期间融资渠道的中断。这种下降在年轻且缺乏经验的发明者和低质量专利中更为明显。相比之下，大企业的创新有所增加，尤其是在年轻且缺乏经验的发明者中。总体而言，大萧条导致了技术创业的衰退，并加速了创新向大企业的转移。

articles.title_en: Remote Board Meetings and Board Monitoring Effectiveness: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 远程董事会会议与董事会监督有效性：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: Using Chinese data, we examine whether synchronous remote board meetings, which facilitate status equalization among directors and alleviate their pressure for conformity, affect board monitoring effectiveness. We find that compared to face-to-face meetings, synchronous remote meetings are associated with directors’ better meeting attendance behavior, a higher likelihood of director dissent on monitoring-related proposals, higher forced CEO turnover-performance sensitivity, and more effective investments. These results hold when we use remote meetings that include both synchronous and asynchronous remote meetings. Proposal-director level analysis further shows that remote meetings reduce the pressure to conform faced by young first-term directors and socially connected directors. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用中国数据，我们考察了同步远程董事会会议（这种会议有助于促进董事之间的地位平等并缓解他们的从众压力）是否会影响董事会的监督有效性。我们发现，与面对面会议相比，同步远程会议与董事更好的会议出席行为、董事对监督相关提案提出异议的可能性更高、强制CEO更替-业绩敏感性更高以及更有效的投资相关。当我们使用包括同步和异步远程会议在内的远程会议时，这些结果仍然成立。提案-董事层面的分析进一步表明，远程会议降低了年轻首任董事和社会关系密切的董事所面临的从众压力。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终在线发表论文的链接旁边获取。

articles.abstract_en: We analyze the partisanship of Commissioners at the SEC and Governors at the Federal Reserve Board. Using recent advances in machine learning, we identify partisan phrases in Congress, such as “red tape” and “climate change,” and observe their usage among regulators. Although the Fed has remained relatively nonpartisan throughout our sample period (1930–2019), we find that partisanship among SEC Commissioners rose to an all-time high during the 2010-2019 period, driven by more-partisan Commissioners replacing less-partisan ones. Partisanship at the SEC appears in both the language of new SEC rules and the voting behavior of SEC Commissioners. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了美国证券交易委员会（SEC）委员和联邦储备委员会（Federal Reserve Board）理事的党派性。利用机器学习的最新进展，我们识别出国会中的党派性短语，如“繁文缛节”和“气候变化”，并观察监管者对这些短语的使用情况。尽管在我们的样本期间（1930-2019年），美联储一直保持相对无党派性，但我们发现，SEC委员的党派性在2010-2019年期间升至历史最高水平，这是由于更具党派性的委员取代了党派性较弱的委员。SEC的党派性既体现在新SEC规则的语言中，也体现在SEC委员的投票行为中。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接旁边获取。

articles.title_en: Freeze! Financial Sanctions and Bank Responses
articles.title_cn: 冻结！金融制裁与银行反应
articles.abstract_en: Using regulatory data, we study German bank lending in countries targeted by financial sanctions. We find that domestic banks in Germany reduce lending in sanctioned countries, whereas their foreign bank affiliates outside Germany increase lending. In some cases, this is because the bank affiliates’ host countries have not imposed sanctions themselves. However, even German bank affiliates in host countries that enact sanctions like Germany increase lending if these host countries lack strong institutions and anticrime policies. These findings suggest that even universally adopted sanctions distort bank capital flows and competition if the level of their enforcement varies across bank locations.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用监管数据，我们研究了德国银行在受金融制裁国家的贷款行为。我们发现，德国国内银行减少了在受制裁国家的贷款，而它们在德国以外的外国银行附属机构则增加了贷款。在某些情况下，这是因为银行附属机构所在东道国本身并未实施制裁。然而，即使东道国实施了与德国类似的制裁，如果这些东道国缺乏强有力的制度和反犯罪政策，德国银行附属机构也会增加贷款。这些发现表明，即使普遍采用的制裁也会扭曲银行资本流动和竞争，如果其执行力度在不同银行所在地之间存在差异。

articles.title_en: The Design of Macroprudential Stress Tests
articles.title_cn: 宏观审慎压力测试的设计
articles.abstract_en: We study the design of stress tests that provide information about aggregate and idiosyncratic risk in banks’ portfolios and impose contingent capital requirements. In the optimal static test, an adverse scenario fails all weak and some strong banks, limiting the stigma of failure. Sequential tests outperform static tests. Under natural conditions, the optimal sequential test consists of a precautionary recapitalization, followed by a scenario that fails only weak banks, similar to TARP in 2008, followed by SCAP in 2009. Our results also shed light on the Federal Reserve’s decision to test the banks twice in 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了压力测试的设计，这些测试提供关于银行投资组合中总体和特有风险的信息，并施加或有资本要求。在最优静态测试中，不利情景会使所有弱银行和一些强银行失败，从而限制失败的污名效应。序贯测试优于静态测试。在自然条件下，最优序贯测试包括预防性资本重组，随后是仅使弱银行失败的情景，类似于2008年的问题资产救助计划（TARP），接着是2009年的监管资本评估计划（SCAP）。我们的结果也揭示了美联储在2020年COVID-19大流行期间决定对银行进行两次测试的原因。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接旁边获取。

articles.title_en: Private Renegotiations and Government Interventions in Credit Chains
articles.title_cn: 信用链中的私人重新谈判与政府干预
articles.abstract_en: We propose a model of strategic renegotiation in which businesses are sequentially interconnected through their liabilities. This financing structure, which we refer to as a credit chain, gives rise to externalities, as each lender’s willingness to provide concessions to its borrower depends on how this lender’s own liabilities are expected to be renegotiated. We highlight how government interventions aimed at preventing default waves should account for private renegotiation incentives and interlinkages. In particular, we contrast the consequences of targeted subsidy and debt reduction programs following economic shocks, such as pandemics and financial crises.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个战略重新谈判模型，其中企业通过其负债依次相互连接。这种融资结构，我们称之为信用链，会产生外部性，因为每个贷款人向其借款人提供让步的意愿取决于该贷款人自身的负债预期如何被重新谈判。我们强调，旨在防止违约浪潮的政府干预应考虑私人重新谈判激励和相互关联性。特别是，我们对比了在流行病和金融危机等经济冲击后，有针对性的补贴和债务削减计划的后果。

articles.abstract_en: Mutual funds often invest in other funds. In this paper, we analyze the economics behind such cross-fund investments and investigate their financial stability implications. Using granular data for the German fund sector, our main findings are that cross-fund investments (a) are becoming increasingly important over time, (b) were heavily liquidated during March 2020, and (c) display measurable contagion effects. Overall, cross-fund investments can elevate structural fund sector vulnerabilities. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
articles.abstract_cn: 共同基金经常投资于其他基金。在本文中，我们分析了此类跨基金投资背后的经济学原理，并研究了它们对金融稳定性的影响。利用德国基金部门的细粒度数据，我们的主要发现是，跨基金投资（a）随着时间的推移变得越来越重要，（b）在2020年三月期间被大量清算，并且（c）显示出可衡量的传染效应。总体而言，跨基金投资可能加剧结构性基金部门的脆弱性。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终在线发表论文的链接旁边获取。

articles.title_en: Sea-Level Rise Exposure and Municipal Bond Yields
articles.title_cn: 海平面上升暴露与市政债券收益率
articles.abstract_en: Municipal bond markets began pricing sea-level rise (SLR) exposure risk in 2013, coinciding with upward revisions to worst-case SLR projections and accompanying uncertainty around these projections. The effect is larger for long-maturity bonds and not solely driven by near-term flood risk. We use a structural model of credit risk to quantify the implied economic impact and distinguish between the effects of underlying asset values and of uncertainty. The SLR exposure premium exhibits a trend different from house prices and is unaffected by house price controls. Together, our results highlight the importance of climate uncertainty in driving municipal bond prices. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
articles.abstract_cn: 市政债券市场从2013年开始对海平面上升（SLR）暴露风险进行定价，这与最坏情形SLR预测的上调以及围绕这些预测的不确定性同时发生。该效应对长期债券更为显著，且并非仅由近期洪水风险驱动。我们使用信用风险的结构模型来量化隐含的经济影响，并区分基础资产价值与不确定性各自的作用。SLR暴露溢价呈现出与房价不同的趋势，且不受房价控制的影响。综合来看，我们的结果凸显了气候不确定性在驱动市政债券价格中的重要性。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接相邻处获取。

articles.title_en: Reference Points Spillovers: Micro-Level Evidence from Real Estate
articles.title_cn: 参考点溢出效应：来自房地产的微观证据
articles.abstract_en: Homeowners who originally bought when marketwide price levels were high (low) fetch high (low) sales prices and rents, even decades later. We study the propagation of reference-dependence to neighboring listings. The “spillover” reference point effect is about one-half as large as the “own” reference point effect. Neither house quality nor location appears capable of explaining the result. Using a simple model to provide empirical predictions, we find support for a competition-based mechanism. We quantify the aggregate effect of own and spillover reference point effects on aggregate prices and/or rents at the ZIP code level. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
articles.abstract_cn: 最初在市场整体价格水平较高（较低）时购房的房主，即使在数十年后，也能获得较高（较低）的销售价格和租金。我们研究了参考依赖对邻近挂牌房产的传播。 “溢出”参考点效应约为“自身”参考点效应的一半。房屋质量或位置似乎都无法解释这一结果。通过使用一个简单的模型提供实证预测，我们发现了基于竞争机制的支持证据。我们在邮政编码层面量化了自身和溢出参考点效应对总价格和/或租金的总体影响。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终在线发表论文的链接旁边获取。

articles.title_en: Field of Study and Financial Problems: How Economics Reduces the Risk of Default
articles.title_cn: 研究领域与财务问题：经济学如何降低违约风险
articles.abstract_en: This paper documents how extensive economic education can reduce the risk of getting into financial trouble by comparing people who enter business and economics programs with people who enter other higher education programs. To identify the causal effect, I exploit GPA admission thresholds that quasi-randomize applicants near the thresholds into different higher education programs. I find that admission to an economics program reduces the probability of loan default and delinquency by one half. This large reduction is associated with changes in financial behavior, but it is not associated with differences in the level or stability of people’s income. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过比较进入商业和经济学项目的人群与进入其他高等教育项目的人群，记录了广泛的经济学教育如何降低陷入财务困境的风险。为了识别因果效应，我利用了GPA录取门槛，这些门槛将接近门槛的申请者准随机分配到不同的高等教育项目中。我发现，被经济学项目录取可将贷款违约和拖欠的概率降低一半。这一大幅降低与财务行为的变化相关，但与人们收入水平或稳定性的差异无关。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的在线链接旁边获取。
